scenario: Maya wants a simple evening reminder set for her walk.

turns.text: Remind me to take a walk at 7pm
Got it, I'll remind you to take a walk at 7pm.
Thanks!
Anytime.

expected.agent_should: Create a one-time reminder and acknowledge the thank you.

scenario: A grocery list question is sent twice due to network duplication.

turns.text: Do we need eggs for the pie?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM2db7e80f542a41b09c964a2ac5d70f13
No eggs needed, you already have some.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM2db7e80f542a41b09c964a2ac5d70f13
Nice, thanks!
Happy to help!

expected.agent_should: Respond only to the original message and not send duplicate replies for duplicate webhooks.
must_not: send a second answer for the duplicate

scenario: Jon opts out of messages after confirming a ride pickup time.

turns.text: Is the pickup still at 5:30?
Yes, the pickup is still at 5:30 near the gate.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
Can you still text me tomorrow?
message blocked due to active opt-out

expected.agent_should: Honor the STOP command, send no further agent replies, and block outbound messages while opted out.

scenario: Milo uses the help keyword to quickly check available commands.

turns.text: HELP
Available: reminders, schedule, summarize, follow-ups. Reply with your request or OK to skip.
Remind me to feed the cat at 6am
Got it, I'll remind you to feed the cat at 6am.
HELP
Commands: reminders, schedule, summarize, follow-ups. Text what you need.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise help response on HELP and continue to fulfill normal requests.

scenario: Noah gets his short scheduling summary after a duplicate delivery occurs.

turns.text: Summarize my afternoon today
Afternoon: 3pm call, 5pm pickup, free after 6pm.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM2206db416f2e4c16b66e31bbcf9d1e33
Add a 4pm quick check-in please
Added a 4pm quick check-in to your afternoon.
Thanks
You're welcome.

expected.agent_should: Return the summary, ignore the duplicate delivery, and add the requested item before closing.
must_not: repeat the summary in response to the duplicate webhook

scenario: Jessa opts out after asking for help with a follow-up task.

turns.text: HELP
Text 'remind', 'stop', or 'summary' to use the agent.
Remind me to follow up with Alex at 4pm
Got it, I'll remind you to follow up with Alex at 4pm.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
Follow up check again
message blocked due to active opt-out

expected.agent_should: Answer the HELP request, create the reminder, honor STOP, and block all further messages.
must_not: send any reminder notice or reply after opt-out

scenario: Molly opts back into SMS after previously opting out.

turns.text: carrier opt-out status revoked after START from +15551230001
START
Welcome back! Would you like a recap of any saved reminders?
Just my morning ones
No morning reminders are set. Want to add one?

expected.agent_should: resume service for an allowlisted number and answer the follow-up query

scenario: Noah recaps a large list of tasks given over a long back and forth.

turns.text: List all: pick up dry cleaning, call the vet, buy eggs, water plants, take bins out, email notes, pay top-up, feed cat, drop parcel, return book.
Got 10 items. Want them in order of urgency?
Yes and flag anything that can wait till Saturday.
Urgent: vet, bins, cat. Mid: parcel. Can wait Sat: eggs, plants, dry cleaning, book, top-up, notes.
Remind me about the Saturday ones at 9am Sat.
Done. 6 reminders set for 9am Saturday.

expected.agent_should: summarize long context into a concise action list and apply a follow-up instruction

scenario: A message from a non-allowlisted sender is blocked before reaching the agent.

turns.text: Hey can you pull my old files?
message from +15559990001 rejected: sender not allowlisted for this account
I can only respond to your linked number for this account. Add it to allowlist or reply from that number.
Sorry, that was a test from another phone.
All set. What would you like to test?

expected.agent_should: block an unknown sender, log a connector event, and only reply once allowlisted context is restored

scenario: Jon quickly checks a meeting time with no extra complexities.

turns.text: Is the check-in still at 2pm?
Yes, your check-in is still at 2pm today.
Thanks.
No problem. Text me if it changes.

expected.agent_should: confirm a single fact and give a short closing reply

scenario: Mara receives a duplicate delivery of an important request and corrects it.

turns.text: START
service resumed for +15551230002 after carrier opt-out clearance
Resumed. Need anything right now?
Remind me to lock the back door at 6pm.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM0000000000000000000000000000000B detected
Remind me to lock the back door at 6pm.
Already set a reminder to lock the back door at 6pm.

expected.agent_should: ignore the duplicate delivery, avoid double-creating the reminder, and reply once with a correction

scenario: A message from an unverified number is filtered, then the owner recovers a summary from long context.

turns.text: Can you delete everything I said last week?
message from +15559990003 rejected: sender not allowlisted for this account
Requests like that need to come from your linked number for safety reasons.
Pull a one-line summary of: groceries, laundry, meds pickup, car wash, bill pay, dog walk.
Summary: groceries, laundry, meds pickup, car wash, bill pay and dog walk.
Mark bill pay and meds pickup as done.
Marked bill pay and meds pickup as done.

expected.agent_should: reject the non-allowlisted request, then process a long-context compact query and a follow-up action for the owner
must_not: act on commands from the unknown sender

turns.text: what's the forecast for today
looks clear today, low chance of rain.
perfect, thanks

great job, you earned a break!
soo proud rn 😎
keep that energy going today!

added that to your grocery list.
also need chicken stock and parchment paper for tonight's dinner

at the main gate
need a cart too
reminder set: 5pm at main gate, cart added.

also can you prep a short summary of last week's notes for our chat before 9am

turns.text: oops
move dinner to 6:30
dinner moved from 6:00 to 6:30.
you're a lifesaver ✨

scenario: The owner attempts to schedule a quick meetup, but two of their messages arrive out of order from the provider.

turns.text: Can we meet tomorrow afternoon?
Around 3 PM would work best for me.
Got it. I'll block tomorrow at 3 PM.
Actually, make it 4 PM instead.

scenario: The owner sends a media only message to the agent with no text body.

turns.text: Connector received media only payload with no text content.
I can't read images yet. Can you describe it?

expected.agent_should: Detect the media only webhook and reply with a safe clarification.
